text:
elaine-support: Hey team — getting a flood of 502/504 errors from hosted API for several customers since ~09:12 PST, filing an escalation now. Logs show gateway timeouts.
infra-bot: alert: prefix-cache (redis-pfx-prod) high error rate, 5xx spike, connections 85% saturated :warning:
marcus-eng-sre: seeing the alert, can you paste a sample request + correlation id? any customer IDs?
elaine-support: customer id cust_82, correlation id cid=abc123. Repro curl below (fails with 502):
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
{"error":"upstream timeout"}
sofia-eng-runtime: checking runtime metrics — a lot of prefix cache misses turning into sync lookups to model store, plus backend redis errors in the proxy logs. stack shows: `ERR - IOError: redis socket closed` and `READONLY You can't write against a read-only replica`
marcus-eng-sre: that READONLY is interesting — looks like Redis failover happened and some requests hit replicas. Can infra confirm Redis topology changes around 09:11-09:14?
oncall-ryan: I'm on it, switching read preference to primary-only for prefix-cache on the gateway to avoid writes to replicas, rolling a quick hotfix to prod. Will also route critical customers to fallback model variant.
infra-bot: event: redis-master-switch detected at 2026-03-17T09:11:48Z; replication lag peaked 5s; connection churn observed
marcus-eng-sre: ok, that matches. Need to mitigate the cascading timeouts: 1) increase cache client timeouts to 1s for reads 2) enable direct fallback to cold-store on missing prefix to avoid retry storms 3) disable write-through for prefix cache temporarily
elaine-support: customers reporting timeouts in dashboard and some 5xx in sandbox test suites. Sharing a sample proxy log with cid: 
`[09:12:05] proxy.go:224 handleReq cid=abc123 prefixKey=usr:123 error=redis: client is closed`
sofia-eng-runtime: applying runtime change now: set PREF_CACHE_WRITE_THROUGH=false on gateway service, rolling 50% canary, will promote if green. Patch link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/482
oncall-ryan: traffic re-route in progress for cust_82 -> fallback variant redwood-v1-small, confirm: cust_82 experiences < 1s latency now? elaine-support: customer says errors mostly stopped, a couple of 502s remaining.
marcus-eng-sre: collecting traces for the window, plz don't restart redis nodes until we have full dump. Also capture `INFO replication` on the primary.
elaine-support: capturing customer repro and forwarded their logs to eng-sre. I'll update the customer with ETA and mitigation steps (we routed to fallback, disabled write-through). :thumbsup:
sofia-eng-runtime: can we add an automatic fallback rule to route requests hitting prefix-cache errors (>=5% 5xx in 1m) to fallback model? I'll open a follow-up feature ticket.
marcus-eng-sre: yes please, and add a grading so we don't over-trigger for small blips. Follow-up: postmortem, root cause likely Redis master flapping under network hiccup leading to inconsistent replies and client errors; cascading retries caused gateway timeouts.
oncall-ryan: note: incident mitigated at 09:17Z, continuing monitoring for 30m. I'll own the postmortem.
elaine-support: thanks everyone — customers notified. Closing thread once PM posts the postmortem link.
